thesis: The episode introduces Angus Cameron, founder and CIO of Liminal Capital, who transitioned from a discretionary trading career in Asia to a machine learning-driven approach focused on trade structuring and position management. Cameron describes his unconventional path, which included spending a year in a Zen monastery in Japan to learn the language before securing a role at Bankers Trust in the early 1990s, a decision he made without regret.
